column2: It’s a microchip you put inside your body.
Even if cats turn out to be evil, no way I’d\nbe able to resist giving them pets!
Yeah, you can’t help but want to scritch the cuties!
Cats are mysterious. Something that cute\nhas to be a gift from the cosmos!
Those ears... They've held the secrets to\npulling the heart strings of all weaboos\nsince the dawn of time...
You’re basically fully consisted from instant\nmeals and energy drinks, aren’t you Qtie?
Oh my GAWD! If this is true, I never have to\ncook again! Processed food 4 EVER!
What’s your favorite instant meal Qtie?
No wayz... Could the reason I can talk to Yunyun\nbe the magic of instant meals?!
Nooo! That’s thanks to our mutual DENPA LUV!
Dunno who thought of that one,\nbut it's pretty funny.
Looks like Agent Ibis isn't woke about animal cruelty.
Proof that laws won't change anything.\nThere's always a loophole.
Lots of app icons are birds, aren't they?
That really pushy language app icon is a bird too,\nisn't it?
DUH!!!! This one is so true. They’ve done\nstudies about it, just look at da results!!
Yup, my beloved moe songs are on repeat erryday!
Opening yourself to the word of moe in\nDenpa songs rlly makes you feel purified.
The phrase “late-night” gives it that\nsecretive, underground feel.
When I think late-night anime sponsors, I think\nmusic labels and as seen on TV stuff.
Late-night anime is demon worship?\nIf the characters were demons, maybe.
Demons can make people delulu, waste\ntheir lives, and are nothing but fantasy.\nPretty similar to anime actually!
You have lots of figures in your\nroom, don’t you Qtie?
I’m usually good with 2D but... They’re so otaku!\nAnd giving something you love form is nice.
The day I first got my hands on a Yunyun figure,\nI felt myself get closer to otaku enlightenment.
With or without a figure, if you feel that\nYUNYUN LUV, you’re an indoctrinated otaku!
Wait, did I accidentally perform some spirit\nritual with my figures?! Is that how\nI’m talking with Yunyun?
I’m not a spirit, I’m a demon! Plus, Qtie and I\nare connected by the miracle of Denpa, nothing else!
Qtie, what’s even the point of a Vtuber?\nThere’s already tons of cute, real people!
Eh, I like them, but none are as cute as you,\nYunyun. Vtubers are just real people\nwrapped in a 2D package.
So many new video streaming platforms\nthese days, huh!
Too many for my brain to handle...\nI miss Vine.
People are hooked on the word ‘reincarnation’\nthese days.
eUuUGUgH. Even hearing the word Monday\ngives me heartburn.
Not even God is safe from the Monday Blues.
Hikikomori neets have no day off. We’re\nalways suffering, on a bed of nails and guilt...
Whoa Qtie! You’re doing your best, and that’s\nfive stars in my book!
If we get Mondays off thanks to these secret\nsociety guys, I’m sure everyone would be hype!
Right!! Erm... hey...\nWhat day of the week is it anyway?
This one’s funny, but old as conspiracy theories go.\nI’ve seen people say Finland isn’t real, either.
Srsly?!\nLot’s of cogito ergo sum types online I see.
There are lots of animals that don’t seem real.\nLike, that one beaver that screamed like a dude!
I’m pretty sure that beaver only exists\nin edited audio form, Qtie.
With this way of thinking, even Yunyun turns\ninto some kind of dangerous thing.
Yup! 100% of people who have ever known me\nhave eventually died!
Qtie, do you drink alcohol at all?
Heh. Who needs to drink when I can get dЯunk off YUNYUN!
It’s all about eating, drinking, doing whatever\nya want! The healthiest lifestyle is one\nwith no stress.
All I want is you, Yunyun.
Religion is all about idol worship.\nGuess there's a lot in common with fandom.
Having to sneak around and turn on the TV\nwithout Mommy noticing is pretty doki doki inducing.
